episodes.synopsis: The Miburo take a trip to Osaka to unwind and predictably run into trouble.
episodes.title: Wild Brawl

episodes.synopsis: Kondo goes to settle Serizawa's killings before the law, but a corrupt official has the Miburo in his sights.
episodes.title: The Path of Humanity

episodes.synopsis: After accepting Nio's suggestion, the Miburo prepare to welcome new members.
episodes.title: A Lone Sheep

episodes.synopsis: The Miburo break into factions backing Serizawa and Kondo. Hijikata tries to defuse the crisis.
episodes.title: Infamy

episodes.synopsis: Taro struggles to make himself useful to Serizawa even as Serizawa's conduct grows increasingly suspect.
episodes.title: Firefly Glow

episodes.synopsis: Serizawa continues to make enemies. An encounter on a routine patrols spurs Hijikata to pick a side.
episodes.title: Discord

episodes.synopsis: A palace coup brings the Miburo new duties, but not all their allies like their growing prestige.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Duo

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of Niimi's apparent suicide, Kondo resolves to kill Serizawa, but Hijikata has plans of his own.
episodes.title: Near Yet Far

episodes.synopsis: The Miburo gather for a lavish party. Serizawa acts unusually cheerful while Hijikata plots his murder.
episodes.title: The Path of Asura

episodes.synopsis: Hijikata launches his assassination attempt, only to find Serizawa ready and waiting for him.
episodes.title: The Arena

episodes.synopsis: Okita struggles against Serizawa, while Hijikata suffers a crisis of confidence.
episodes.title: A Clumsy Strike

episodes.synopsis: Nio leads the wounded Serizawa out of Hijikata's trap, but to what purpose?
episodes.title: Serizawa Kamo

episodes.synopsis: Serizawa faces Kondo. What will Nio make of the dying samurai's last moments?
episodes.title: Blue Era

episodes.synopsis: After Serizawa entrusts the Miburo to Kondo and dies, the group—and Nio, Hajime, and Taro—begin to change.
episodes.title: Song of Beginnings
